title: The Class Pet
description: Three short recordings about choosing and looking after a class hamster.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Choosing a pet
parts.intro: You will hear a teacher, Mrs Evans, and a boy, Nam.

script.speaker: Mrs Evans
script.text: Nam, we're getting a class pet next week. Would you like to help me choose?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Yes, please! Can we have a dog?

script.speaker: Mrs Evans
script.text: No, a dog is too big for our classroom. I'm thinking of a rabbit or a hamster.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: I prefer rabbits. They are soft, and they have long ears.

script.speaker: Mrs Evans
script.text: Rabbits need a lot of space, though. A hamster is small and it's happy in a cage.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Then let's get a hamster. And I have a name idea: Biscuit.

script.speaker: Mrs Evans
script.text: Lovely name. We'll get him on Monday. I'll buy a cage and some food this weekend, so everything is ready.

parts.title: Part 2 · Class rules
parts.intro: You will hear Mrs Evans talking to her class about the hamster.

script.speaker: Mrs Evans
script.text: Class, our hamster has arrived. His name is Biscuit, and he's two years old.

script.speaker: Mrs Evans
script.text: Every day, two children will look after him. They will give him fresh water and food in the morning.

script.speaker: Mrs Evans
script.text: On Fridays, we'll clean his cage. Please wash your hands after you touch him.

script.speaker: Mrs Evans
script.text: Don't wake him up when he's sleeping, and never give him sweets. Seeds and carrots are best.

script.speaker: Mrs Evans
script.text: Biscuit will go home with Linh for the school holiday. I'm sure that every one of you will be kind and careful with him.

parts.title: Part 3 · At home
parts.intro: You will hear Linh talking to her dad.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Dad, can I look after our class hamster in the holidays? Mrs Evans said I can!

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: A hamster? Where will he sleep?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: In my bedroom, next to the window. He needs a quiet place.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Hmm, I'm not sure. What about the cat?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: I'll close the door. Please, Dad! I'll clean the cage every day, I promise.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: OK, OK. But you must do it yourself. I'm not going to help.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Thank you! You're the best dad in the world. I'll tell Mum the good news when she comes home, and she will be happy too.
